language.label: Language
profile.title: Your Profile
profile.guest: You are playing as a guest.
profile.here_note: The signed-in players who have been here in the last few minutes, by their usernames.
profile.asked_you: {name} has asked to be your friend
settings.guest: You play as a guest in this browser. {signin}
settings.guest_signup: You play as a guest in this browser. {signin} or {signup} to keep your games on every device.
settings.ratings_note: A question mark means the rating is provisional. You appear on a game's leaderboard after 5 rated games against at least 3 different people.
settings.make_account_note: Email notifications, direct messages and the global chat are for signed-in players now. This browser confirmed an email address already, so it can become your account at once: choose a username and a password, and your games, and your turn mail, carry on.
settings.name: Name
settings.name_note: Saved in this browser. Games you already joined keep the name you used in them.
settings.accounts_only_html: Email notifications are for signed-in players: sign in to have {brand} mail you when it is your turn.
settings.email_note: Only used for the turn notices you ask for. {brand} mails a link to confirm the address first, and never shows it to other players.
settings.notify: Send me an email when it is my turn
settings.notify_note: Applies to games you join or open from now on; you can change it for each game in its options.
settings.notify_off: Email notifications are not set up on this server. What you choose here is kept in this browser for when they are.
settings.not_an_address: That does not look like an email address.
settings.not_sent: The address could not be sent.
settings.resent: A new confirmation was sent to {address}.
settings.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {address}. Open it and press Confirm (look in the spam folder too).
settings.forgotten: Your address was deleted from the server.
settings.friend_mail: Email me when somebody sends me a friend request
settings.friend_invites: Let other players invite me to games
settings.presence_note_html: Off, you look offline to your friends and are not in Here now. Friends cannot start a message or call with you, but you can write to them, and they can reply.
settings.no_badges: No badges yet. Win a game against another player for your first.
settings.player_page_html: Your player page, as other players see it.
